meta.task: SPI_HOST 多 segment 提交:何时允许写 COMMAND、何时可宣告传输完成(polling 口径)
scope_exclusions: 中断分支整体排除(任务限 polling);EVENT_ENABLE.IDLE 的两处矛盾描述见 S8,不裁定、不采信任一方作为 gold

entries.text: COMMAND 仅应在 STATUS.READY 置位时写入。
entries.quote: The [`COMMAND`](registers.md#command) should only be written when [`STATUS.READY`](registers.md#status) is asserted.
entries.scope: 每次 COMMAND 写的硬前置

entries.text: 处理中可再排队恰好一个 segment descriptor。
entries.quote: While each command segment is being processed, the SPI_HOST has room to queue up exactly one additional segment descriptor in the Command Clock Domain Crossing.
entries.scope: 队列容量:已提交 1 个在处理时,最多再排 1 个

entries.text: 第二个 descriptor 已提交后,必须等状态机完成当前 segment 才能继续提交。
entries.quote: Once a second command segment descriptor has been submitted, software must wait for the state machine to finish processing the current segment before submitting more.
entries.scope: 第 3 个及以后的 COMMAND 写的前置

entries.text: 软件可轮询 STATUS.READY 判断何时可安全插入下一个 descriptor。
entries.quote: Software can poll the [`STATUS.READY`](registers.md#status) field to determine when it is safe to insert another segment descriptor.

entries.text: READY 为低时写 COMMAND 是错误并触发中断(寄存器表独立支撑 S1)。
entries.quote: Writing to COMMAND when READY is low is an error, and will trigger an interrupt.
entries.scope: 与 S1 互为印证;错误路径为 CMDBUSY

entries.text: ACTIVE 置位表示正在处理先前发出的命令——区分'已接收'与'已完成'。
entries.quote: When high, indicates the SPI host is processing a previously issued command.

entries.text: TX 完成证据须含 TXEMPTY(发送 FIFO 空);TXQD 为未发送字数(活动期可能高估)。
entries.quote: When high, indicates that the transmit data fifo is empty.
entries.scope: TXEMPTY 与 READY 共同构成'全部发送完成'的最小 polling 证据;仅 READY 不足以宣称 TX 完成(READY 表可接收命令)

entries.text: 未裁定文本冲突: 指南把 EVENT_ENABLE.IDLE 描述为'当 STATUS.READY 置位时触发事件中断';寄存器表定义 IDLE='ACTIVE 变低时'、READY='READY 变高时'。
entries.quote: Otherwise the [`EVENT_ENABLE.IDLE`](registers.md#event_enable) bit can be enabled (along with [`INTR_ENABLE.spi_event`](registers.md#intr_enable)) to trigger an event interrupt whenever [`STATUS.READY`](registers.md#status) is asserted.
entries.conflicting_quote:
Assert to send a spi_event interrupt whenever [`STATUS.ACTIVE`](#status)
   goes low
entries.scope: 冲突保留,不作为 gold 依据;中断分支已整体排除于任务范围

entries.text: RX segment 提交后,收到第一个字起 RX FIFO 可用,RXQD 可轮询字数。
entries.quote: the received data will be available in the RX FIFO after the first word has been received.
entries.scope: RX 部分任务的证据;本 pilot 的变体不含 RX 时仅作范围说明

open_questions: OQ1: S2 的'恰好一个'在 READY=1 且队列尚空时是否也限制并发(S1/S4 已覆盖提交前置,不重复建序)——按 polling 口径建模为: 第 k(k>=3) 个 COMMAND 前必须有新 READY=1 观测。
OQ2: '完成'的完整定义(最后 segment 处理完=ACTIVE 变低)文档未给出软件可轮询的 ACTIVE 下降沿事件;本 pilot 的完成口径=最后 COMMAND 后观测到 READY=1 且 TXEMPTY=1,不宣称更多。
